name: Icon
description:
One of the ~5,000 Appica icons (https://appica.dev/ui/icons), by its canonical name.

  Icon(:star)                                              # outline, 24px, 1.5 stroke
  Icon(:star_filled, size: 20, class: "text-warning-emphasis")
  Icon("arrow-back-up", stroke_width: 2, aria_label: "Undo")   # labelled => role="img"
  Button { Icon(:download, data: { icon: "start" }); plain "Export" }

Names are the catalog's kebab-case names; symbols with underscores and the React PascalCase names work too (:arrow_back_up, "ArrowBackUp"). Filled icons end in -filled. Icons are decorative (aria-hidden) unless given an aria_label.
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes AppicaUI (e.g. `Icon(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

examples.name: Usage
examples.notes: Any catalog name - kebab-case, a symbol with underscores, or the React PascalCase name.
examples.code:
phlex do
  if AppicaUI::IconLibrary.index.key?(AppicaUI::IconLibrary.normalize(name))
    Icon(name, size: size.to_i, stroke_width: stroke_width.to_f, class: color.to_s)
  else
    p(class: "text-error-emphasis text-sm") { "No icon named “#{name}” - try the Gallery." }
  end
end

examples.name: Gallery
examples.notes: Browse and search every icon. Click one to copy its `Icon(...)` call.

examples.name: Sizes
examples.notes: `size:` sets width and height in pixels (24 by default) - or size it with a `size-*` class.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "text-foreground-intense flex items-end gap-6") do
    [ 16, 20, 24, 32, 48 ].each do |size|
      div(class: "flex flex-col items-center gap-2") do
        Icon(:photo, size:)
        span(class: "text-foreground-muted text-xs") { size.to_s }
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Stroke width
examples.notes: Outline icons take `stroke_width:` (1.5 by default); filled icons ignore it.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "text-foreground-intense flex items-end gap-6") do
    [ 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5 ].each do |stroke_width|
      div(class: "flex flex-col items-center gap-2") do
        Icon(:settings, size: 32, stroke_width:)
        span(class: "text-foreground-muted text-xs") { stroke_width.to_s }
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Outline & filled
examples.notes: Filled variants are separate icons with a `-filled` suffix.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "text-foreground-intense grid grid-cols-5 gap-6") do
    %i[ heart star bell bookmark circle_check ].each do |name|
      div(class: "flex flex-col items-center gap-3") do
        Icon(name, size: 28)
        Icon(:"#{name}_filled", size: 28)
        span(class: "text-foreground-muted text-xs") { name.to_s }
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Color
examples.notes: Icons draw with currentColor - color them with a `text-*` class (or `color:`).
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex items-center gap-5") do
    %w[ text-primary text-secondary-emphasis text-info-emphasis text-success-emphasis text-warning-emphasis text-error-emphasis ].each do |color|
      Icon(:circle_check_filled, size: 28, class: color)
    end
    Icon(:heart_filled, size: 28, color: "#ec4899")
  end
end

examples.name: In a button
examples.notes: Buttons size their icons; `data: { icon: "start" }` (or "end") tightens the padding on that side.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3") do
    Button do
      Icon(:download, data: { icon: "start" })
      plain "Export"
    end
    Button(variant: :outline) do
      plain "Next"
      Icon(:arrow_right, data: { icon: "end" }, class: "rtl:rotate-180")
    end
    Button(variant: :soft, icon: true, aria_label: "Settings") { Icon(:settings) }
  end
end

examples.name: Accessible icon
examples.notes:
Icons are aria-hidden by default. A standalone meaningful icon gets `aria_label:`, which
renders it as role="img" instead.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "text-foreground-intense flex items-center gap-2 text-sm") do
    Icon(:alert_triangle_filled, size: 20, class: "text-warning-emphasis", aria_label: "Warning")
    span { "Storage almost full" }
  end
end
